rules.when: <= ~15-20 stops and you need a provable optimum
capacities, multiple vehicles, or time windows

rules.use: never nearest-neighbor alone -- it is a baseline, not a solution

always: know your gap-to-optimal by checking against exact on a small same-type instance
thesis: give up on optimality on purpose; a 2%-from-optimal route in one second beats a proven-optimal route delivered never
